user.title: Family Dashboard - Roster
user.description: Enter your family's names (comma-separated). You'll set each person's color on the next screen.

avatars.title: Family Dashboard - Avatars
avatars.description: Pick an avatar for {name}. You can pick from a bigger picture grid, or add your own photos, later from Settings.

birthdates.title: Family Dashboard - Birthdates
birthdates.description: Optionally set {name}'s birthdate as DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 21/06/2015). Powers the Birthdays overlay on the Calendar tab - leave blank to skip.

features.title: Family Dashboard - Features
features.description: Choose which features {name} wants. Settings/Roster is always included for everyone.

link_users.title: Family Dashboard - Link HA User (optional)
link_users.description: Optionally link {name} to an existing Home Assistant user account (accounts already linked to another family member aren't listed). This lets them see their own personal dashboard view later. Leave blank to skip - you can set this later.

calendar_none_found.title: Family Dashboard - Calendar
calendar_none_found.description: No calendars were found on this Home Assistant instance yet. Supported types: Google Calendar (set up under Settings > Devices & Services), or a zero-config Local Calendar. Continue for now - you can map a calendar for these family members later by re-running this wizard, once one exists.

calendar.title: Family Dashboard - Calendar
calendar.description: Optionally map an existing calendar for {name}, and separately, a notify target for reminders. Leave either blank to skip - you can set this later. A calendar named "Family" (if one exists) is automatically shared with everyone - no setup needed here.

lists.title: Family Dashboard - Lists
lists.description: Choose which lists to create for {name} (To-Do, Shopping, Packing, Gift Ideas, Custom). Each person's lists are private to them.

add_chore.title: Family Dashboard - Chores
add_chore.description: {count} chore(s) added so far. Add another for one of: {roster} - or leave the name blank to move on to Rewards.

add_reward.title: Family Dashboard - Rewards
add_reward.description: {count} reward(s) added so far. Add another for one of: {roster} - or leave the name blank to finish setup.

confirm.title: Family Dashboard - Confirm

error.roster_empty: Enter at least one family member name.
error.invalid_birthdate: Enter a date as DD/MM/YYYY, e.g. 21/06/2015.

abort.already_configured: Family Dashboard has already been set up on this instance.

unmapped_user.title: {name} isn't in your Family Dashboard roster
unmapped_user.description: The Home Assistant user "{name}" doesn't have a Family Dashboard roster member linked to them, so they currently see the shared Kiosk view (everyone's calendars, lists, and chores) instead of their own. To fix, go to Settings > Devices & Services > Family Dashboard > Configure > Add Family Member and link them. If this user should never be part of the roster (e.g. an admin or kiosk-device account), you can ignore this issue and it will stay ignored.
